name: Ask Fern customer assistant
description: Chat assistant on the Fernhill website that answers delivery, returns and product questions
purpose: Answer routine customer questions and hand over to staff when unsure
human_oversight: Handover to a human agent on request or after two unanswered questions; weekly sampling of transcripts
notes: Art 50 disclosure banner in place; retention period agreed with supplier

name: TalentLens CV shortlisting
description: Supplier tool that ranks job applications against a role profile
purpose: Help recruiters shortlist applicants for branch and warehouse roles
annex_area: Annex III point 4(a) recruitment and selection
human_oversight: A recruiter reviews every ranking and records the decision; no automatic rejection
notes: Pilot covers UK roles only; Annex III duties apply from 2 December 2027 but the system is treated as high-risk now by policy

name: Stock demand forecasting model
description: In-house model that suggests weekly order quantities per branch
purpose: Suggest order quantities to reduce stock-outs and surplus
human_oversight: Planner reviews and can override every suggested quantity
notes: Own-use system; screening record kept instead of a full impact assessment

name: GenAssist staff assistant
description: General-purpose generative AI assistant offered to office staff
purpose: Draft and summarise internal documents and emails
human_oversight: Staff remain responsible for checking outputs; acceptable use policy limits what may be entered
notes: Art 4 literacy duty applies; Art 50 duties apply if content is published to the public

name: Invoice data extraction
description: Machine learning service that reads supplier invoices into the finance system
purpose: Extract invoice fields to cut manual keying
human_oversight: Low-confidence fields go to manual check; three-way match with purchase order before payment
notes: Review is overdue soon; used as an example of a scheduled review

name: Trade credit limit recommender
description: Proposed in-house model that recommends credit limits for trade accounts
purpose: Recommend credit limits for new and existing trade accounts
annex_area: Annex III point 5(b) may apply to sole traders; classification under review
human_oversight: Credit Controller makes every decision; no automated refusals
notes: Do not start build until classification and impact assessment are complete
